qAndA.answer: ChatGPT for creative writing and strategic thinking, Bard for real-time search capabilities, and Claude for customer service and support.
qAndA.question: What were the examples of specialized AI tools provided by Ryan?

qAndA.answer: Nikolaus believes that the more involvement from the open-source community, the better the AI development will be. He cites the growth of GitHub as an example of this trend.
qAndA.question: What is the significance of the open-source community in AI development according to Nikolaus?

qAndA.answer: Scott envisions a future where specialized AI deployments will be more prevalent than a single dominant AI, similar to the diverse market of CRMs.
qAndA.question: How does Scott perceive the future of AI competition?

qAndA.answer: Scott specifically mentions Google and Anthropic as examples of companies that are likely to make significant contributions to the AI field in the future.
qAndA.question: Which companies does Scott see as being successful in the upcoming AI landscape?

qAndA.answer: Ryan explains that ChatGPT's browser feature was disabled because it was accessing content behind paywalls without authorization.
qAndA.question: Why was ChatGPT's browser feature disabled?
